title: Kuramoto Coupling — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Kuramoto Coupling's rich face: what the Shop gathered and made for each section, and the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.

pieces.title: intro narration · Kokoro, af_heart
pieces.caption: The first line of the Shop's Round 1 reel, spoken: *how populations of oscillators find a shared rhythm.*
The model in one line, then the crowd's togetherness — each shown twice, in symbols and in words.

pieces.title: narration for the uncoupled phasors · Kokoro
pieces.caption: The voice-over this clip was cut to in the Round 1 reel.

**Path B, heard.** The claim above, made audible and checked: a saw driver pulls its follower onto a true octave; a square wave, with no second harmonic, cannot — but it can lock the twelfth. The lock thresholds match K ≥ 2|Δf| ⁄ bₘ.

**The performable boundary, in miniature.** A simpler cousin of the neurological synthesizer — one pitch cloud rather than an attractor spectrum — but the same move: K as the knob between scatter and coherence.
pieces.near: The neurological synthesizer maps this directly

pieces.caption: **Bright idea #38, played.** Stubbornness (K_receive → 0) sets *where* a locked crowd would settle; whether the crowd can get there takes pull (K_send) too. The settle point is every voice's pitch weighted by K_send ÷ K_receive — the simulation lands on it to the hundredth of a hertz.
